status.rest_of_day: for the rest of the day
status.error_detail: Check the computer running inkdoor serve
status.no_busy_detail: No calendar is set to mark you busy

cli.description: E-ink calendar display for your door.
cli.config_missing: Could not find '{path}'. Copy config.example.toml to config.toml and paste your links.
cli.kept_last_config: Invalid config, still using the last valid one: {message}
cli.port_in_use: Port {port} is already in use. Change [server] port in config.toml or stop the other program.
cli.password_new: New admin password: {password}  (saved in {path}; other sessions are logged out)
cli.password_no_folder: The folder '{folder}' does not exist. Create it or pass --config with the path to config.toml.
cli.password_write_failed: Could not save the password in '{path}' ({error}). Run the command as the user that runs inkdoor.
cli.no_password: No admin password yet: run inkdoor password
cli.no_address: Could not find this computer's address on the local network.
cli.config_defaults: No valid config yet ({message}): showing the setup or error screen

help.lang: language for the screen and messages (overrides the config)
help.serve: render and serve the screen continuously
help.password: create a new admin password and print it
help.url: print the admin address for other devices on the network

check.not_configured: link not pasted into config.toml yet
check.unreachable: could not reach the address. Check the link and the internet connection.
check.blocked: address not allowed: the link points to this computer or to a link-local address.
check.too_large: the calendar is too big (more than {mb} MB).
check.timeout: the server took too long to answer (more than {seconds} seconds).
check.redirects: the link sends you through too many other addresses. Copy the final link from your calendar app.
check.bad_link: this is not a valid link. It must start with https://, http:// or webcal://.
check.denied: access denied (HTTP {status}). Usually your company blocks published calendars, or the link was unpublished.
check.not_found: link not found (HTTP 404). Publish the calendar again and copy the ICS link.
check.html_page: the link opened a web page, not a calendar. Use the link ending in .ics (not the HTML one).
check.not_ics: the content is not an ICS calendar
check.no_events:
no events in the next 14 days. If the calendar is not empty,
     make sure you published the right one.

all_day_found.one: {n} all-day event in the next 14 days
all_day_found.other: {n} all-day events in the next 14 days

check.busy_only:
the link only shows 'Busy', without meeting titles.
     Publish it again with 'Can view all details'.
     If that option is missing, your organization limits publishing: the door status
     still works, but the list will only say 'Busy'.
check.timezone:
many events in the middle of the night: the time zone may be wrong.
     Check that the times above match your calendar app.
check.fix_errors: Fix the items marked with ✖ and run the check again.

config_error.timezone: unknown timezone '{value}'. Use a name like America/New_York.
config_error.hour: {key} must be a whole hour from 0 to 24 (got {value}).
config_error.workdays: workdays must be a list of numbers from 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday).
config_error.calendar_duplicate: two calendars are named '{name}'; names must be unique.
config_error.style: calendar '{name}': style must be solid, striped or outline (got {value}).
config_error.calendar_url: calendar '{name}': url must be a link in quotes, like "https://...".
config_error.calendar_busy: calendar '{name}': busy must be true or false.
config_error.calendar_label: calendar '{name}': status_label must be text in quotes, like "Out".
config_error.tasks_url: [tasks] url must be a link in quotes, like "https://...".
config_error.encoding: config.toml is not UTF-8. Save it again as UTF-8 (in Notepad: File → Save as → Encoding: UTF-8).
config_error.section: [{section}] has the wrong shape. Compare it with config.example.toml.
config_error.admin_enabled: [admin] enabled must be true or false (got {value}).
config_error.allowed_hosts: [admin] allowed_hosts must be a list of host names, like ["door.example"].
config_error.permission: Cannot read {path}: the file must belong to the inkdoor user (chown inkdoor)

admin.title: inkdoor admin
admin.try_again: Too many attempts. Try again in {wait}.
admin.no_password: No admin password has been set. On the server, run inkdoor password and try again.
admin.login_expired: This form expired. Please try again.
admin.bad_host: This address is not allowed. Open the admin by the server's IP address, or add this name to allowed_hosts in the [admin] section of config.toml.
admin.log_host_rejected: Refused the Kindle image for a host that is not allowed: {host}
admin.not_rendered: The screen has not been drawn yet.
admin.preview_alt: The screen the Kindle is showing
admin.error_400: The request could not be understood.
admin.error_401: You are not logged in, or your session has ended.
admin.error_403: This request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
admin.error_500: Something went wrong. The error was logged on the server.
admin.error_other: The request could not be completed.
admin.calendars_intro: Events from these calendars appear on the door, each with its own marker. Links stay on this server and are only shown shortened.
admin.no_calendars: No calendars yet. Add one to get started.
admin.field_name_help: Shown in the legend on the door.
admin.field_busy_help: When on, this calendar's events make the door say you are busy. Turn it off for calendars that should only be listed, like reminders.
admin.field_status_label_help: The big word on the door during this calendar's events. Leave empty for “{default}”.
admin.field_link_help_new: The calendar's private ICS address, starting with https:// or webcal://.
admin.field_tasks_link_help_new: The TickTick calendar subscription address, starting with https:// or webcal://.
admin.field_link_help_edit: Leave empty to keep the current link, or paste a new one to replace it.
admin.test_failed: The test could not run. Reload the page and try again.
admin.test_busy: Two tests are already running. Try again in a moment.
admin.test_not_web: This link is not a web address (it was set by editing config.toml), so it is not tested here. Run inkdoor check on the server instead.
admin.saved: Saved. The door will update in a moment.
admin.removed: Removed. The door will update in a moment.
admin.changed_elsewhere: config.toml was changed somewhere else (another tab or a hand edit), so nothing was saved. Check the page and try again.
admin.config_unreadable: config.toml cannot be read, so these settings cannot be changed here: {message}
admin.config_invalid: config.toml has a problem, and saving is refused until it is fixed: {message}
admin.error_config: Nothing was saved because config.toml has a problem: {message}
admin.error_link: config.toml is a symbolic link, so the admin cannot change it: saving would replace the link with a plain file. Edit the file it points to by hand.
admin.error_single_line: Use a single line of plain text.
admin.error_link_invalid: Paste a web link that starts with https://, http:// or webcal://.
admin.error_link_repaste: For your security, a pasted link is never shown again. Paste it once more before saving.
admin.error_overdue_days: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 365.
admin.tasks_intro: Tasks due today, plus overdue ones, from a TickTick calendar subscription (a TickTick Premium feature).
admin.tasks_none: No task list is set up yet.
admin.field_overdue_days_help: Show overdue tasks up to this many days old.
admin.update_requested: Updating the door. The preview changes when the new screen is ready.
admin.update_throttled: The door was updated less than 30 seconds ago. Try again in a moment.
admin.kindle_url_help: Put this address in URL in config.sh on the Kindle.
admin.kindle_url_unknown: Could not find this computer's network address. On the Kindle, use its IP address followed by :{port}/kindle.png.
admin.config_broken_kept: The door keeps using the last settings that worked until it is fixed.
admin.config_broken_defaults: No earlier version works either, so the door shows an error screen.
admin.first_setup: Welcome! Add a calendar to get started. Until then, the door shows the setup screen.
admin.restore_help: Puts back config.toml as it was before the last save. The current file is kept as config.toml.bak, so this can be undone.
admin.confirm_restore: Replace config.toml with the previous version?
admin.restored: Previous version restored. The door will update in a moment.
admin.restore_failed: The previous version cannot be used either: {message}
admin.screen_intro: How the door shows your day. Changes appear on the Kindle at its next refresh.
admin.language_overridden: The language is set when the server starts (--lang or INKDOOR_LANG), so it cannot be changed here.
admin.field_timezone_help: Start typing a city, like America/New_York.
admin.field_hours_help: Whole hours from 0 to 24. Outside these hours, and on days off, the door says “after hours”.
admin.field_min_gap_help: Gaps between meetings shorter than this are not shown as free time.
admin.field_refresh_help: How often the door reads the calendars and redraws the screen.
admin.port_note: To change the port, edit config.toml and restart inkdoor.
admin.error_timezone: Choose a time zone from the list, like America/New_York.
admin.error_clock: Choose one of the clock options.
admin.error_hour: Enter a whole hour from 0 to 24.
admin.error_workday_order: The workday must end after it starts.
admin.error_min_gap: Enter a whole number of minutes from 0 to {high}.
admin.error_refresh: Enter a whole number of minutes from {low} to {high}.

field_new_password_help.one: At least {n} character. Or leave it empty and generate one.
field_new_password_help.other: At least {n} characters (dashes and spaces do not count). Or leave it empty and generate one.

admin.forgot_password: Forgot the password? On the server, run inkdoor password.

error_password_short.other: Use at least {n} characters (dashes and spaces do not count).

admin.error_password_write: Could not save the new password ({error}). The old one still works.
admin.password_changed: Password changed. Other browsers were logged out.
admin.generated_help: Save it now, for example in a password manager: it will not be shown again. Other browsers were logged out.
admin.session_help: Log out when you are done on a shared computer.
